Composition: Show an adult placing a thin decorative patch over a badly cracked chair joint while an observer points to the still-loose support beneath it. Style: Use the attached invidious.png for drawing style only. Match its thick rounded dark-brown contours, simplified rounded shapes, and restrained 2D cartoon shading. Do not copy the reference subject or composition.

Framing: One compact composition, with the complete subject using about 80-90% of the square. Keep all limbs and object tips inside the frame.

Output: 512x512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background and transparent gaps. No text, speech balloons, explanatory captions, numerals, labels, logos or watermark.
